faqs.question: Where is my order?
faqs.answer: Share your order number (for example 1001) and I'll check the live status with the store right away.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Orders are dispatched within 24-48 hours and reach most Indian pin codes in 3-5 working days.

faqs.question: Can I return an item?
faqs.answer: Yes - unopened items in original packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

faqs.question: How do refunds work?
faqs.answer: Once a return is picked up and checked, the refund goes back to your original payment method within 5 working days.

faqs.question: Do your products carry a warranty?
faqs.answer: All audio, wearable and power products carry the manufacturer's warranty - 1 year for boAt and Boult, 6 months for Redmi power banks.

faqs.question: What do you sell?
faqs.answer: Wireless audio, smartwatches and charging accessories - including boAt Airdopes 141 Earbuds, the Redmi Power Bank 20000mAh and the Boult Smartwatch.

policies.title: Return Policy
policies.body: Unopened items in original packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Earbuds and wearables must be sealed to be eligible.

policies.title: Refund Policy
policies.body: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 working days of the returned item passing inspection.

policies.title: Shipping Policy
policies.body: Dispatch within 24-48 hours. Free shipping above Rs.999, Rs.60 flat below that. Delivery in 3-5 working days across India.

policies.title: Warranty
policies.body: Manufacturer warranty: 1 year on boAt and Boult products, 6 months on Redmi power banks. Claims are raised with the brand's service centre using the order number.
